objectives.title: Does adding hsCRP help?
objectives.approved: compare the accuracy of modified Alvarado score (MAS) alone versus MAS plus high sensitivity c-reactive protein (hsCRP) in the diagnosis of acute appendicitis

objectives.title: Does hsCRP distinguish severity?
objectives.approved: determine the diagnostic value of hsCRP in simple acute appendicitis and complicated appendicitis

objectives.title: Does performance vary with age?
objectives.approved: compare the accuracy of combined MAS and hsCRP in children (under 16 years) and adults (16 years and above)

objectives.title: How often was surgery negative?
objectives.approved: determine the rate of negative appendicectomy in the study

objectives.title: Did clinicians feel more confident?
objectives.approved: test the ease of diagnosis of acute appendicitis among resident doctors and medical officers using the combined MAS and hsCRP

objectives.title: What do the monetary records show?
objectives.approved: estimate the direct hospital cost implications of using combined MAS and hsCRP in the evaluation of patients with suspected acute appendicitis
